title: Subpolynomial dimension reduction in Lp

result.label: Subpolynomial dimension reduction in Lp
result.statement: For every fixed 1 p and distortion D > 1, every n -point subset of real L p embeds into ^d with distortion at most D and dimension d=n^ o(1) , answering Naor's sublinear-dimension question for p ≠ 2. In contrast, exact embeddings require worst-case dimension (n^2) when p ≠ 2.
